messages:
mktg_lead: Heads-up: planning a quick kickoff to finalize the embeddable pricing micro-calculator + FAQ copy for EU marketing site launch. Need final tier names, 5 FAQs, and localization notes. Can we sync today? 🙏

jane_marketing: Available 3–3:30pm PT. I'll bring benchmark numbers for conversion.

sam_growth: Do we want 'Starter / Scale / Enterprise' or more product-y names? data showed generic names dropped signups ~6% vs action names last test.

eli_product: Prefer capability-based: 'Developer, Team, Production'. Keeps parity with API docs and product pages.

sofia_localization: If we pick 'Production' that's tricky to translate in FR — could be confused with 'production environment'. Suggest 'Scale' for EMEA clarity.

luke_design: I'll mock a 320x240 embeddable widget with sticky header. Any constraints? Need max copy length for CTA (approx chars).

mktg_lead: Good note Sofia. Can we vote in thread? Also need the 5 FAQs prioritized: billing cadence, overage handling, data retention, SSO/SSO provisioning, refund policy.

sam_growth: My vote: Developer / Scale / Enterprise. Add a small tooltip under 'Scale' to clarify intended use cases.

sofia_localization: Vote: Developer / Scale / Enterprise ✅ works for FR/DE/ES. I'll prep translation notes for ambiguous terms.

eli_product: +1. Also add: 'Which model families are available on each tier?' to the FAQ list. That question reduces pre-sales PD calls.

jane_marketing: Metrics: bench shows embeddable micro-calculator inline on pricing page increases trial starts ~12%. Sharing the deck in 10m.

mktg_lead: Copy owner: @jane_marketing. Component owner: @luke_design. Dev owner: @max_frontend. Localization: @sofia_localization. Go/NoGo cutoff: test must show >=1.5% net CR lift in A/B.

max_frontend: Can pick this up tonight — need the pricing estimate API endpoint and a sample payload/response to wire the UI.

eli_product: Use: GET /api/v1/pricing/estimate?monthly=true. Example response: ```{ "tier": "Scale", "monthly_cost": 120, "notes": ["includes 200k tokens"] }```

max_frontend: Thanks — I'll prototype with canned responses to unblock Luke.

deploybot: deploybot: new branch created: pricing/microcalc-embed (CI started) :rocket:

jane_marketing: I'll draft the 5 FAQs and a short webinar blurb to promote the new calculator. Posting copy here in a follow-up.

mktg_lead: :thumbsup: Aim to ship to staging by Fri EOD. If A/B is positive, schedule prod rollout next Wed. Please flag any blockers by EOD tomorrow.
